# Yauli

> Yauli is a baby tracking and parenting companion that gives families one calm, shared timeline for their baby's day.

Yauli helps parents and carers record and review feeds, pumping, nappies, sleep, baths, observations, temperature, medication, vaccines, other care items, and growth measurements. Several items can be recorded together in one Medication event and edited together. The current web application provides a shared, live-updating family timeline; daily feed, sleep, pump, and nappy summaries; and 7-, 30-, or 90-day insights for sleep, feeds, nappies, and growth. Families can invite other carers and optionally receive AI-generated daily report emails when that service is configured.

The public website is https://getyauli.com/. Family timelines and baby records are private and require sign-in. Yauli supports parenting organisation and record keeping; it does not provide medical diagnosis or replace professional medical advice.

The web application is available today. Scheduled weekly reports, dedicated milestone views, shareable paediatrician reports, and direct conversational tracking through ChatGPT and MCP are planned and are not yet generally available.

## Official pages

- [Yauli homepage](https://getyauli.com/): Product overview and access to the web application.
- [Yauli source repository](https://github.com/andreistefanciprian/yauli): Public project overview, current features, architecture, and development status.
